title: CAMP ANNIVERSARY SMOKE
description: Long-running camps now mark survival anniversaries with crooked banner poles, campfire smoke shapes, and a tiny recap of every ridiculous thing that failed to kill the player.
consequence: The camp starts keeping birthday candles in the ash pile.

title: FINAL VOW FUNERAL
description: Completed NPC questlines now end with a real burial rite, a named grave, and no repeat favor loop quietly waiting behind the chapel like a bored intern.
consequence: The questline learns to stay buried.

title: DESTINY STREAK LEDGER
description: Runs now convert omens, prophecies, cursed bargains, and heroic sacrifices into a daily stamped ledger with escalating fate bonuses for consecutive attempts.

title: SANITIZED LEGACY VAULT
description: Old victories now move into a clean account vault with approved labels, compressed medals, and no messy squad notes cluttering the seasonal comeback screen.
consequence: The memory palace installs fluorescent lighting.
